subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------EXT.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 170 (EVOL-8). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject; EXT-FT (extended functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: POST (postulation), BIA (bi-aitional) and TRS (transition). From POST: CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From CULT-INFO-B: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From BIA: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From TRS: C-RH (composite research).
